analyst_view.overall: PSG are top of the league phase with 12 points and 20 goals from 4 games and have won 12 in a row, most recently 3-2 at Nice; Roma are 20th with 4 points and at risk of going out early, though they are unbeaten in Serie A and beat Parma 5-1 with four goals from Donyell Malen. PSG lost Désiré Doué to a serious right knee injury at Nice and Kvaratskhelia is out with a torn ACL; the numbers count both, and Dembélé, Marquinhos and Nuno Mendes are back. Roma have Svilar and Dybala back, Pellegrini is out (counted), and Rensch and Balerdi are doubts. Swedish referee Glenn Nyberg (3.5 cards a game) is named and already counted. I found nothing the numbers can't see, so I stay with them.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.5 goals, lifted by both teams' scoring form (about +6% PSG, +4% Roma) and taking Doué (-6%) and Kvaratskhelia (-4%) off PSG. Dembélé is back to lead PSG's attack and Malen is in form for Roma, which fits that picture, so I stay at 3.5.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.9 corners, with Roma's busy recent corner count already adding about 3%. PSG will have most of the ball and Gasperini's Roma attack wide with wing-backs Wesley and Molina, but nothing in the team news changes how many corners either side wins, so I stay at about 9.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.2 cards, already cut about 10% for referee Glenn Nyberg's low card count and for both sides' quiet recent records (PSG only 3 in their last 6). Roma's man-to-man pressing tends to draw fouls against a side that keeps the ball, which is why their share is larger; with no rivalry or suspension angle, I stay at 3.2.

shots.text: The numbers say 32.3 shots, with both sides' high recent shot counts already adding 9-11%. Losing Doué costs PSG a shooter, but Dembélé is back to take that role and PSG should dominate the ball at home, so I stay at about 32.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 13.1 shots on target, pushed up by PSG's very accurate recent run (+22%). Doué is in the numbers' missing list, and Svilar returning in Roma's goal doesn't change how many shots reach it, so I stay at 13.1.
